prompt: A combo box picks a drink size and a label shows its price. Complete updatePrice so the label always shows the selected price formatted like "$2.50" -- including right after construction.
explanation: A JComboBox fires an ActionEvent whenever its selection changes, and getSelectedIndex() lines up with the array the box was built from, so parallel arrays give a clean index-based lookup. Listeners only run on future events, which is why the constructor must call updatePrice() once by hand to establish the initial state. Pinning Locale.US in String.format keeps the decimal point a '.' on every machine.
hints: getSelectedIndex() returns 0, 1, or 2 -- the same index works for the PRICES array.
Adding a listener does not run it; call updatePrice() yourself at the end of the constructor.
